Name: Sah’ra Jane Crystalline

Other names: Sarrah, Sar, Witch Girl, Sarrah Crystalline, Sarrah Jane, Sah’ra nay Kion, Sarrah nay Kion, Starlight, Freckles, Ma shaa lira, my dear, Mage Crystalline, Sarrah-Mage, Miss Sarrah

How it’s said: SAH-rah

Summary
A Valisian mage and historian from Akunda, from the high-ranking Crystalline family. She’s curious, clever and easily flustered, and she joins Tom’s quest for the shards of the Staff of Light at her uncle Malos’s request, knowing all along that the staff can’t do what Tom has been promised. The book follows her struggle between loyalty to her uncle and loyalty to Tom.

Details
Realm: Mortal world
Race: Human
Gender: Female
People: Akundain
Hair: purple, straight (curls in humidity)
Eyes: purple
Skin: olive
Marks: freckles
Jewellery: small red stud earrings, magenta multi-diamond pendant necklace
Clothing: sleeveless Akundain dress with a four-panel lower skirt, armbands, grey sash, embroidered leather boots
Magic: Valisian (casts pink-magenta and violet)
Weapon: staff with a crystal tip, which shrinks to clip onto her belt
Mount: Crystal

Occupation: historian and archaeologist; former magic instructor to Princess Aaliyah
Member of: the Historical Society of Alvora (HSA)
POV symbol: ✧

Appearance
Sarrah has long purple hair, usually straight but prone to curling in damp air, purple eyes, freckles and olive skin. She dresses in the sleeveless style of Akunda, which suits its heat: a dress with a four-panel lower skirt, armbands, a grey sash and embroidered leather boots. She wears small red stud earrings and a magenta multi-diamond pendant.

Personality
Sarrah is a born academic, obsessed with history and with the people who left artefacts behind. She talks with her hands when she’s excited, and she would rather brush dirt off a sherd by hand than use magic, “because it’s more fun”. She blushes easily and gets flustered around Tom. She hates being babied, and pushes her magic further than she should to prove she can manage. Her loyalty to her uncle runs deep, and so does her guilt. The secret she keeps from Tom eats at her for most of the book.

History
Sarrah was born in Akunda to Zah’ra Crystalline, of a high-ranking Akundain family, and Kion, an outsider who took the Crystalline name when he married. Her parents lead all of Akunda’s healers. She has a younger sister, Lia, and there is some friction between them.

Her maternal uncle, Malos, head mage of Magica, has always watched over her and her magic closely. His care comes with passive comments that sting. She studied at Magica around the same time as Princess Ruby, though Ruby never noticed her there. Back in Akunda she taught Princess Aaliyah magic, including one disastrous lesson in which Aaliyah’s fireball missed the target and hit a barrel of wine. As a member of the Historical Society of Alvora, she travels in search of ancient artefacts. She is riding her dragon, Crystal, on one such trip when Book 1 begins.

Abilities
Sarrah is a gifted Valisian mage. Her magic draws on her own stamina, and pushing too far leaves her drained or close to collapse. Her repertoire includes:

fireballs, and a flame spiral of her own invention
a location spell that spins a web of violet light towards what she seeks
platforms of light, heat barriers and gusts of wind
a spectral wolf, and conjured objects such as a replica of Jim’s bow
healing, from closing wounds to setting broken bones

Malos can sense her energy from a distance.

Notes per book

Shards of Light (Book 1).

While hunting for sherds of ancient Gith in the canyons, Sarrah is cornered by Elamen and rescued by Tom. She spends the night at his house in Silverbrick Lane.
When Malos reveals Tom’s heritage and sends him after the shards, he asks Sarrah to go too. She knows, or strongly suspects, that the staff cannot locate people, but she stays silent out of loyalty to her uncle and her own curiosity.
In Akunda her research confirms it.
On the shore of Aurelis she confronts Malos, who talks her into keeping the secret “for the sake of the world” and for Tom’s sake.
She heals Lillia after Tom rescues her. Elsey and Ruby encourage her feelings for Tom.
On the climb in Ursvald she finally confesses the lie and kisses Tom before turning back. From the foot of the mountain she sees the flash of demonic magic.
When Tom returns wounded and broken by Ralos’s theft of the shards, Sarrah takes command of the ship, heals his shattered shoulder and blames herself. Tom kisses her and tells her it isn’t her fault.

Book 5. Sarrah is the mother of Zia Smith with Tom.

Spoilers
Sarrah’s knowledge of her uncle’s lie is clear to readers from Book 1, chapter 6. Tom learns of it in chapter 19, the same chapter as their first kiss. Zia Smith first appears in Book 5.
